findings.summary: The spec's enumeration deliverable (full-repo PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE occurrence list with per-item disposition, and the parent_handoff_receipt_digest / receipt-chain-walker enumeration) is answered in code comments and the sealed verification record rather than as a discrete tree artifact. This final review's independent read-only re-enumeration confirms the substantive outcome: every remaining PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE site is the classifier's own transport branch (dd_actors.py:183-223), the pre-existing egress transport-exhausted and run-timeout paths (dd_pipeline.py:391, dd_actors.py:495 — genuinely transport), the plugin adapter's script spawn/timeout failures (outside the agent-run result contract), or read-only reporting/tests/fixtures; audit._check_receipt_chain is the only chain walker consuming (and needing) the retry edge — dd_replay walks sealed per-attempt receipt files and correctly needs none.

Auxiliary product commit 96e83266 extends tests/test_gate_authority_text.py SCAN_EXCLUDED_DIRS with gitignored tool-cache directories (.venv, .ruff_cache, .pytest_cache) so acceptance cmd 2 (make verify) is reproducible in a worktree carrying those caches (a ruff cache blob can contain the shadow byte pair by chance; the production checkout uses different cache keys and never saw it). Outside the spec's named deliverables, but judgment-surface-neutral: the D5 anchors, shadow definition, and red-flip mutation test are unchanged and no existing test was deleted or weakened (sealed make verify: 3070 passed / 3071 total, exit 0).
